text.title: Worth knowing
text.item stock-not-restored: Cancelling a paid order does not give the copies back to the shelf.
text.item stock-not-restored note: decrementStock runs when an order is paid and nothing reverses it
text.item order-total-zero: A new order is stored with a total of zero cents.
text.item order-total-zero note: placeOrder never adds up the lines, so the total stays 0 until something else sets it
